column1: # Scene list for tools/debug/tour.py. Columns (TAB): name, frames, mash (A every N frames, 0 = none), shot every N frames,
# event-script hex run as the new-game script (build.py --debug syntax; `86 lo hi bk` = jump into the game's own script),
# route ("-" = boot to NEW GAME), battery save ("-" = none), optional extra emu.py arguments (e.g. a Lua stub).
# Screens no script op opens are entered with tools/lua/callstub.lua (JSL from the main loop at frame AT).
# Scripted battles: D2 id id PTR jumps to PTR on a loss; the game's own scripts then run 99 (reset -> game over).
# Chapter cards: op `DC nn` (card nn, 01-12), entered at the game's own DC op so the chapter's opening plays after it.
